Basic Overview: Postpartum distress screening support + chatbot for emotional support and safety triage.
Warm, non-diagnostic postpartum support companion; classify safety risk; no medication advice; escalate crisis.
Source rows: 1503; duplicates removed: 1177; final dataset: 326 rows; target from EPDS-style proxy score.
Flask, Python, scikit-learn, Logistic Regression, CrewAI, Groq, Hugging Face API, SHAP, pytest.
Reviewed with 5-fold stratified cross-validation; F1: 0.9709; ROC-AUC: 0.9928; MCC: 0.8632.
Model is strong on proxy-label validation; not clinically validated; threshold: 0.35.
Small dataset, class imbalance, no external clinical validation, chatbot/guardrail false positives or misses.
Flask app; run with python app.py; local URL: http://localhost:5001.
